_note: Copy to profile.json in this folder and fill in. profile.json is gitignored - it names the company and its books, so it stays per-install. Credentials do NOT go here; they live in ../mcp-server/.env
_groupHintsNote: Name fragments that suggest a counterparty inside the same group. Flagged in the UI, never asserted. Empty is a fine default.
_creditTermNote: Days of credit. Required for the file-import route: aging reports bucket by months since invoice and carry no due date, so nothing else can say what is actually overdue. Ask the user - never assume 30.
